argv:
R=01d586ddbc5fcd78659557c4e93a6ee8517b87d1; E=.ufo/evidence/round-16/round-gate; K=~/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin
echo "## e69b488 identity"; git show -s --format="%H committer=%cI author=%aI %s" e69b488
git merge-base --is-ancestor e69b488 $R && echo "e69b488 is an ancestor of read rev"
echo "## pre-registered files at e69b488 vs read rev"
for f in round-gate.defects.spec predictions.json suite.txt; do printf "%s e69b488=%s read-rev=%s\n" $f "$(git show e69b488:$E/$f | sha256sum | cut -c1-64)" "$(git show $R:$E/$f | sha256sum | cut -c1-64)"; done
echo "## sweep evidence is absent at e69b488 and added later"
git cat-file -e e69b488:$E/sweep/results.tsv 2>/dev/null && echo "results.tsv present at e69b488" || echo "results.tsv absent at e69b488"
git log --diff-filter=A --format="results.tsv added in %h committer=%cI" -- $E/sweep/results.tsv
grep -m1 "^MUTATE_DATE:" $E/sweep/sweep.log
echo "## kumitate pin"
git -C $K rev-parse "364f1d5^{commit}"
git -C $K show 364f1d5:scripts/round-gate.mjs | sha256sum
git -C $K show 364f1d5:scripts/round-gate.mjs | wc -lc
git -C $K log -1 --format="last-touching commit of scripts/round-gate.mjs at HEAD: %H" HEAD -- scripts/round-gate.mjs
